_readme: BM text for the Bahasa Malaysia area pages (ms/area/*.html). One entry per area page, keyed by the English file name without .html. build_static_listings.py builds a BM page ONLY for areas listed here. {place} in _common is replaced with the area's BM place name. _kawasan holds the BM text for the area directory (ms/kawasan.html); its tags list only the landmark lines that differ from English.

faq: Bagaimana nak bertanya tentang hartanah di {place}?
WhatsApp Hani terus di 012-545 9182. Hani Properties berdaftar di bawah ERA Real Estate (E(1)1773/3, REN 84031) dan biasanya membalas dalam masa sejam.
Boleh Hani Properties bantu cari unit di {place} yang belum disenaraikan?
Boleh. WhatsApp Hani atau isi borang permintaan, dan Hani akan cari terus unit yang sesuai di {place}.
